str.upper()¶

Return a copy of the string with all the cased characters converted to uppercase.

>>> 'Mycelia'.upper()
'MYCELIA'
str.lower()¶

Return a copy of the string with all the cased characters converted to lowercase.

str.strip(chars=None)¶

Return a copy of the string with the leading and trailing characters removed. Whitespace is removed by default.

>>> '   spacious   '.strip()
'spacious'
str.split(sep=None, maxsplit=-1)¶

Return a list of the words in the string, using sep as the delimiter string.

>>> '1,2,3'.split(',')
['1', '2', '3']
str.replace(old, new, count=-1)¶

Return a copy of the string with all occurrences of substring old replaced by new.

str.title()¶

Return a titlecased version of the string where words start with an uppercase character.

>>> 'hello world'.title()
'Hello World'
str.join(iterable)¶

Return a string which is the concatenation of the strings in iterable, separated by the string.

str.format(*args)¶

Perform a string formatting operation.

>>> '{}'.format(1)
'1'
